names.note: The calendar’s own name page for him is «Сергий (Сорокин), иеромонах, прмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Прмч. Сергия». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The year the day line closes with, «(1937)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 декабря ст. ст. — «Прмч. Сергия (1937).»

attestations.note: A line of his own. «Прмч.» is преподобномученик, which this corpus reads as `venerable-martyr`, and the name page’s «иеромонах» gives the grade the line does not: hieromonk. THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar’s twentieth-century entries. No folder held him: a Cyrillic grep for «Сорокин» over every `saint.json` returns nothing. The day page prints eleven hymns and none is under his name.
